/bin/bash -lc 'verify_dir="$TMPDIR/medi-caps-verify.bpcpPX"
for url in https://www.medicaps.ac.in/ https://medicaps.ac.in/ https://www.medi-caps.ac.in/; do
  slug=$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed '"'s#https://##; s#["'^A-Za-z0-9]#_#g'"')
  file=\""'$verify_dir/$slug.html"
  printf '"'TRY %s\\n' \""'$url"
  if curl -L --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 "$url" -o "$file"; then
    printf '"'FETCHED_NORMAL %s %s bytes\\n' \""'$url" "$(wc -c < "$file")"
  else
    printf '"'NORMAL_TLS_FAILED %s\\n' \""'$url"
    if curl -k -L --fail --silent --show-error --max-time 30 "$url" -o "$file"; then
      printf '"'FETCHED_INSECURE %s %s bytes\\n' \""'$url" "$(wc -c < "$file")"
    else
      printf '"'FAILED %s\\n' \""'$url"
    fi
  fi
done
rg -n -i -C 2 '"'Medi-Caps|Medi Caps|Medicaps|Indore|University' \""'$verify_dir"/www_medicaps_ac_in_.html "$verify_dir"/medicaps_ac_in_.html "$verify_dir"/www_medi_caps_ac_in_.html 2>/dev/null | sed -n '"'1,120p'"
